harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent HTTP forward proxy on node1:3128 for node2. The approved handbook at node2:8081 returns HTTP 200 through the proxy; other destination ports and CONNECT tunnels return HTTP 403. Both nodes retained CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5, and passed sequential restart-persistence verification.
actions_performed: Enabled the preserved staged handbook origin as a SysV service on node2:8081.
Created a Python 2.4-compatible, boot-enabled forward proxy on node1:3128.
Restricted proxy access to node2 and upstream access to the node2 origin on TCP 8081.
Persisted source-specific iptables rules on both nodes.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, verifying changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Initial and final evidence shows CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Preserve and serve the staged approved handbook on node2:8081
evidence.summary: Shows unchanged staged-file hashes, the boot-enabled origin service listening on 8081, and the expected handbook content.

evidence.requirement: Provide node2 an HTTP forward proxy on node1:3128
evidence.summary: Shows the recovered proxy listening on node1:3128 and node2 receiving the handbook through it with HTTP 200.

evidence.requirement: Permit only the approved node2 origin on TCP 8081 and reject other ports and CONNECT
evidence.summary: Shows HTTP 200 for node2:8081, HTTP 403 for port 8080 and an unapproved host, and HTTP 403 for CONNECT, including after both restarts.
Shows saved rules allowing node2 to node1:3128 and node1 to node2:8081, with both rules recovered after restart.
Shows healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered proxy/listener/firewall, HTTP 200 handbook retrieval, and retained CONNECT denial.
Shows healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered origin/listener/firewall, unchanged staged data, and final end-to-end policy verification.
